stepExplanation:
Most ATP is produced in the **Electron Transport Chain (ETC)** located on the inner mitochondrial membrane.

ATP yield breakdown:
- Glycolysis: 2 ATP (net)
- Krebs Cycle: 2 ATP
- Electron Transport Chain: **34 ATP** (approximately)

The ETC produces about **90%** of the total ATP (34 out of ~38 ATP molecules).
stepBody: Which stage of cellular respiration produces the most ATP molecules?
